contexts.text: Under Fruit, see this reference. AC 6418.
A fruitful one () = fructification from truth; for fruitfulness, like birth, in the spiritual sense, is that of truth and good...
From manure the earth is fertilized...

As all truths proceed from the Lord through the Spiritual Kingdom, Joseph is called the son of a fruitful one, the son of a fruitful one near a fountain. By a fruitful one is signified spiritual good, which is the good of charity.
The son of a fruitful one near a fountain = fructification by truths from the Word. The son of a fruitful one = fructification. AE 483:13.
